# Playtester
A discovery platform for upcoming indie game alphas, betas, and demos.

> Discover alphas, betas, playtests, and demos for upcoming indie games across Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, and more.

Playtester helps players discover alphas, betas, and demos across platforms. We curate the best ongoing alphas, betas, demos, and playtests to share with thousands of players every day.

**Key features**
- Real-time feed of active playtests and demos
- Powerful filters (platform, genre, tags)
- Community upvotes for quality curation
- Direct join/sign-up links
- Short video previews

**Supported platforms**
Steam, PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, Epic Games Store, itch.io, GOG.com, Nintendo eShop, App Store, Google Play

**Meta**
Last-Updated: 2026-07-02
Contact: contact@playtester.io
Homepage: https://playtester.io
